notes: Switched the video engine back to ExoPlayer (the one used through 1.0.13) after the VLC engine introduced in 1.0.14 caused freezing on Rai 4K and other 4K/HDR channels. The original MP2 audio fix (Nove HD and similar channels on cheap Android TV sticks) is preserved via a small dedicated software decoder that only engages on devices with no hardware MP2 support. Install size is back down to pre-1.0.14 levels.
